hero.name: Pullaiah
hero.headline: Crafting modern BI and cloud analytics with clean models, creative motion in reporting, and scalable data architecture — currently on Insights at ABC Fitness Solutions.

experienceIntro: Nine years across Infosys → LTIMindtree → ABC Fitness Insights. Click a stop on the timeline or use ← → keys.

points: Lead root-cause investigations across Insights Reporting — Power BI semantic models, SSRS paginated reports, Synapse / Azure SQL, and ADF pipelines.
Trace data gaps source-first — staging → ETL stored procedures → reporting layer, validated across many locations and edge cases before any fix is proposed.
Build and harden reporting logic — DAX measures, model relationships, and paginated-report dataset queries for fitness operations analytics (membership, payments, revenue, check-ins).
Partner with Data Engineering on production fixes — stored procedure and view changes, schema impact analysis, pipeline mapping checks, and proof queries.
Communicate findings to product and support — concise summaries plus technical write-ups, and mentor teammates on investigation practices.

experience.role: Senior Data Analyst / Fabric Engineer | Specialist — Data Engineering
points: Lead Power BI and Microsoft Fabric delivery for Fortune 500 clients across Product, Finance, and Executive stakeholders.
Architect solutions on large semantic models (up to ~110GB) with performance tuning, incremental refresh, and gateway stability.
Automate model ops with Tabular Editor and C# scripts; design star schemas and DAX calculation groups.
Build and manage Azure Data Factory pipelines feeding enterprise semantic models.
Implement NLP/text analytics in live dashboards; enforce RLS, governed workspaces, and analyst training playbooks.

experience.role: Power BI Developer / Data Analyst / Data Engineer | Engineering Lead
points: Designed and delivered 40+ dashboards and analytical models across business units for 150+ global users.
Engineered Incremental Refresh for semantic models up to ~40GB; cut stakeholder manual effort by ~60%.
Migrated Tableau prototypes to production Power BI; authored knowledge bases and trained 20+ analysts.
Built ETL/dataflows with SQL/MySQL and Azure integrations; used DAX Studio, Tabular Editor, and ALM Toolkit for versioning and tuning.
